note: Example. A project copies this to docs/anim/sampling.json. engine threejs: adapter is project code exporting clips(), meta(clip), rest(), sampleWorld(clip, t) (see sample-threejs.mjs); or glb, a file with baked clips. engine godot: scene holds a Skeleton3D and an AnimationPlayer. render is the project's own command that writes a viewable clip for the owner; {clip} and {out} are substituted.
